name: wasm_build_tool
description: Compile a Go source tree into a WASM capability bundle and install it under skills.d/wasm/<id>/. The manifest_toml must be a valid 0.8.0 envelope manifest (see docs/MANIFEST-SCHEMA.md). The sources map keys are relative paths inside the module root (e.g., go.mod, main.go). The bundle is installed unsigned; the daemon auto-signs at next boot discovery.

manifest_toml.description: Raw TOML text of the envelope manifest (alf_envelope_version=1, kind=wasm-tool|wasm-app, id, version, name, description, optional [[fs.reads]] / [[fs.writes]] scopes). See docs/MANIFEST-SCHEMA.md §3.

sources.description: File map keyed by relative path inside the Go module root. Must include go.mod and at least one .go file. Larger trees with subpkg/ are supported via paths like 'subpkg/foo.go'.
